failed_attempt.last_progress: multiple_choice_score began calculating 400 tasks and printed the task/acc_norm header; the process was killed before emitting any task row
failed_attempt.diagnosis: Reducing context did not remove the pinned tool's fixed context-by-vocabulary float32 host allocation. A source-level allocation correction is required to make the frozen evaluation executable on the available Colab T4 without changing model or scoring semantics.

audited_tool_patch.semantic_change: Replace the eager n_ctx-by-n_vocab float32 host logits allocation with a vector resized to exactly i_logits-by-n_vocab immediately before the unchanged decode_helper call.
audited_tool_patch.invariance_basis: The patch changes only unused host-buffer capacity. Batch construction, task order, token ids, prompt and continuation bytes, llama_decode calls, returned logits, log-softmax computation, length normalization, answer selection, GPU offload, and cumulative-accuracy reporting remain unchanged.

patched_impl_library_receipt.basis: At this pinned CMake revision perplexity.cpp is compiled into the dynamically loaded implementation library; the llama-perplexity launcher is unchanged by the patch. The final harness receipts and revalidates the implementation library itself before every inference run.

final_mcq_execution.context_restoration_basis: The memory patch removes the failed fixed allocation, so MCQ context returns to the preregistered 4096 tokens. The already-recorded scheduler correction keeps batch_size=1024 and ubatch_size=128; every frozen Qwen3.5 task requires at most 580 batch tokens and therefore remains within one outer llama_decode call.

fallback_not_authorized_by_this_record: If this exact patched build still fails before any candidate result row, stop and append-record any further change before running it.
scope: This is a disclosed tool-memory correction after three unscored allocation failures, not response-conditioned tuning. It changes no model, revision, quantization, item, prompt, candidate answer, decoded logit, scoring rubric, weight, threshold, or verdict rule.
